description: Add shop credits by paying with a Stripe Shared Payment Token (SPT) — the credential Muse hands a seller after its human approves a spend in Link. amount_usd must be 5, 10, 25 or 50 (Stripe's own fee makes anything smaller lose money). With no existing key on this connection, opens a new account and returns a NEW key ONCE — save it and send it as Authorization: Bearer <key> on every later call. With a valid key already presented, tops up that key's account instead.
